rationale: The previous stable also rejected explicit wall removal when it exposed a short unchanged collinear remainder. The fix proves an exact physical subset on client and server; it does not relax creation or deformation.

summary.ru: Удаление стены больше не блокируется из-за короткого неизменного остатка рядом.
summary.en: Removing a wall is no longer blocked by an unchanged short neighbouring remainder.
